tabs.label: Homepage
tabs.title: Welcome to Garden For Life
tabs.content: The homepage serves as the main landing page of the application, providing users with an overview of the project and quick access to key features. It includes navigation links and a welcoming introduction to guide visitors through the site.

tabs.label: Contact
tabs.title: Contact Us
tabs.content: The contact page allows users to get in touch with the team. It features a contact form where visitors can submit their inquiries, feedback, or support requests. This page helps facilitate communication between users and the organization.
